description: Validation test cases for ensuring helmfile-driven deployment pattern compliance

testCases.name: kubectl-availability
testCases.description: Verify kubectl is available and context is set
testCases.validation: kubectl command should succeed and return a context name

testCases.name: multi-environment-support
testCases.description: Verify helmfile.yaml defines both local and production environments
testCases.validation: helmfile.yaml should contain 'local' and 'production' environment definitions

testCases.name: istio-templates-exist
testCases.description: Verify all required Istio templates and production configuration files exist
testCases.validation: All Istio VirtualService, DestinationRule templates and production.values.yaml should exist

testCases.name: helmfile-template-local
testCases.description: Verify helmfile can render templates for local environment without errors
testCases.validation: helmfile template command should succeed and generate Deployments and Services

testCases.name: helmfile-template-production
testCases.description: Verify helmfile can render templates for production environment with Istio resources
testCases.validation: helmfile template command should succeed and generate Istio VirtualServices and DestinationRules for production

testCases.name: no-kubectl-antipatterns
testCases.description: Verify all deployments in metabob namespace are managed by Helm

commands: kubectl get deployments,statefulsets -n metabob -l app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=Helm -o name

testCases.validation: All deployments and statefulsets should have app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=Helm label

testCases.name: no-configuration-drift
testCases.description: Verify running deployment versions match configured values
testCases.validation: Running deployment image version should match configured version in values file

examples.description: Run from project root with defaults
